name: CMC Magnetics Corporation
summary: CMC Magnetics Corporation engages in the manufacture and sales of optical discs and peripheral products in Taiwan, the Americas, the rest of Asia, Europe, and internationally. It is involved in the manufacturing and trading of photoelectronic products; trading other electronic products; and manufacture, distribution, and sales of audiovisual content, as well as in related commercial operations. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
